THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
027
STUDY 043
Satin Oxblood Top & Low Bun
Rights check
Source: 24387.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark brown hair in a neat
high bun, with face-framing strands, smiles softly with
glossy mauve lips. She wears a deep oxblood satin
high-neck top with full sleeves. Behind her, blurred
warm lights and a dark floral arrangement fill the space.
Her expression is relaxed and warm. Soft, warm
evening light, a palette of oxblood, deep brown, and
warm amber highlights. Polished and understated, in
the style of an event candid portrait.
Warm, polished, understated
WORKING NOTES
- The satin texture and oxblood color are the focus.
- Keep the blurred lights for a warm, evening feel.
